scope: fully enabled watcher qualification for the optimized reduced full-model path on P150x4

original_failure.result: NCRISC watcher assert during the UINT32 split-sampler all-gather

root_cause.classification: source inspection plus isolated before/after reproduction
root_cause.detail: For the sampler's one-page UINT32 all-gather, pages_per_packet is one and use_scatter_write is false. The writer correctly sends through the unicast path, but its constructor still initialized unused scatter-write state with only one chunk, violating the scatter API's minimum chunk contract under watcher validation.
root_cause.repair: Compile out scatter-write set_state when use_scatter_write is false in the multicast primary and alternate routes and in the standard unicast writer. The active unicast-write state and data path are unchanged.

isolated_validation.result: pass: production TP4 sampler trace-state matrix under watcher
pass: UINT32 all-gather eager and trace functional cases, PCC 1.0

final_validation.coverage: embedding, sliding and full-attention decoder layers, final norm, LM head, traced greedy, traced top-k/top-p, tt_out_tok feedback, token-out, async collection, cache/page state, and teardown
final_validation.result: pass with clean watcher stop and device teardown
final_validation.storage: Generated watcher logs are losslessly gzip-compressed; stored and uncompressed hashes are recorded.

scope_limit: The generic high-bandwidth all-gather fixture that selects a different fabric firmware configuration remains outside this model-stage fix; its pre-test firmware-size failure is recorded separately and is not a measured-path fallback.
